name: Cafe 4Zero
why_it_matters: Cafe 4Zero is the only named cafe consistently flagged in coverage of Pfutsero town — the rest of the dining scene is what a 2018 traveller's account calls 'rice hotels' (basic local dhabas serving rice with fish/pork/mutton or dal-rice-vegetables). Pfutsero sits at ~2,133m, in Phek district, ~60km from Kohima; commercial dining is genuinely thin, and 4Zero is the most-recommended sit-down option for visitors during the day.
insider_tip: Hours and menu vary day-to-day — call ahead via your homestay or Pfutsero tourism contact. For full meals, plan around lunch; evenings in Pfutsero shut down early. The town is high and cold most of the year — go for hot tea and smoked pork rather than the cold/cafe-style menu.
